title: freshness preset changes the cold window live

setup.note: A mature world (20 spaces, consent 30 days old — not bootstrapping) on the Balanced default. The dispatcher is already running; Settings › Assist changes the preset without a restart.

input_events: Settings › Assist sets freshness = live; tick
Settings › Assist sets freshness = relaxed; tick
an unknown preset is refused; tick

wrong.label: restart-needed
wrong.assert_absent: the running dispatcher kept the old window after the preset changed
